en: A black-and-white postcard view of a historic hilltop complex above a riverside town. In the foreground, barges are moored along the riverbank. Above them rises a large castle-like building with many windows and steep roofs, and behind it stands a Gothic cathedral with tall, ornate twin spires and additional towers. Smaller houses and vegetation cover the slope below. Printed caption text appears at the bottom right of the image.
